verdict.rationale: Docs show the full server-side flow: create applicant → create workflow run (returns SDK token) → collect captures via SDK, plus a hosted no-code alternative (Smart Capture Link) that Entrust hosts on the developer's behalf and redirects customers to, and result retrieval via webhook/polling. This directly matches the story of server-side session creation with either embed (SDK/drop-in) or hosted redirect and result reading. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration (e.g., third-party integration walkthrough) and no explicit code sample of reading the final verification result payload.
